A '''groundcruiser''' was a [[Repulsorlift/Legends|repulsorlift]] [[Hovercraft|surface-effect vehicle]] that was frequently employed by military and police forces. They were typically larger than commercially available [[Speeder/Legends|speeders]]. The [[X10 Groundcruiser]] was a model of groundcruiser used by the [[Corporate Sector Authority/Legends|Corporate Sector Authority]].
